description: Script for comparing failed tests in CTS/VTS test_result.xml files, extracting and displaying test failure information, and generating a CSV report.

methods.name: parse_attrib_path
methods.description: Parses an attribute path string into tags and attribute name.

methods.name: get_test_info
methods.description: Extracts test information from the XML root element based on predefined attribute paths.

methods.name: print_test_infos
methods.description: Prints comparison of test info from two test result datasets in table format.

methods.name: get_result
methods.description: Retrieves the result of a specific test given module, testcase, and test name.

methods.name: read_test_result_xml
methods.description: Reads and parses a test_result.xml file into a structured dictionary.

methods.name: compare_failed_tests
methods.description: Compares failed tests between two test result datasets and writes differences to CSV.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function to parse arguments, read test results, compare, and output report.
